src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v == row[0] and v != 0 for v in row):
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if len(a) == len(b):
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if all(v == vals[0] and v != 0 for v in vals):
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            if len(left[0]) == len(right[0]):
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
    raise ValueError('No equal split around a solid divider')
'''
